Amazon · AI PRODUCT STRATEGY

waste, reimagined.

I explored how AI could make Amazon’s returns and waste ecosystem smarter, more scalable, and easier to operate.

What I did

I evaluated computer vision, predictive ML, agentic AI, and robotics across a 1.2B+ annual returns ecosystem, then translated the strongest opportunities into product requirements and an implementation roadmap.

Why it mattered

The work prioritized three enterprise AI solutions and mapped a 6–24 month path from pilot to scale across Amazon’s global fulfillment network.

McGraw Hill Education · MARKET RESEARCH

reading the market.

A market-research project focused on understanding how leading education platforms compete — and where McGraw Hill could differentiate.

What I did

I analyzed competitor products, positioning, user experiences, and emerging EdTech trends, then synthesized the research into clear themes and strategic recommendations.

Why it mattered

The project turned a broad competitive landscape into actionable insights that supported product positioning and client decision-making.

Hanwha Life AI LAB · AI PRODUCT

art meets intelligence.

I helped shape an AI-powered art investment experience that made art pricing, discovery, and portfolio decisions easier to understand.

What I did

I translated insights from 7,000+ artwork images into PRDs, user journeys, and Figma concepts spanning price explainability, personalized curation, tax simulation, and portfolio diversification.

Why it mattered

The concept connected AI capabilities with a more approachable investment experience inside Hanwha Life’s PLUS investment and gifting platform.

Neptune Cloud · AI / LLM

better prompts. better answers.

I worked on an internal LLM-powered Slack chatbot designed to answer employee questions more clearly and reliably.

What I did

I fine-tuned prompts, tested conversation flows, reviewed outputs, and iterated on wording and structure to improve relevance, clarity, and tone across internal FAQ use cases.

Why it mattered

The project gave me hands-on experience treating prompts and conversation flows as product surfaces — testing not only whether an answer was correct, but whether it was actually useful.

The Health Trust · DATA VISUALIZATION

data that speaks.

I built an interactive dashboard that turned nonprofit survey data into a clearer picture of organizational needs and capacity gaps.

I organized survey data in Power BI and designed views that made patterns easier to explore across respondents, priorities, and areas of need.

Why it mattered

The dashboard helped transform a dense dataset into a decision-making tool that could support The Health Trust’s nonprofit funding and strategy conversations.
